<a id="type-DragTrack"></a>
### DragTrack

Makes a dragged node a value control (a knob, a fader): it moves along the track as variable `variable` goes from `min` to `max`, and the design canvas draws it at the variable's value. Dragging it writes the variable (unless `write` is off); a double tap goes to `defaultValue` (or through `doubleTapValues`), the wheel and arrow keys step it. Inside it `${track.value}`, `${track.progress}`, `${track.dragging}`, `${track.fine}` and `${track.focused}` can be read.

Its settings and geometry are bindable as `drag.track.<field>` (`drag.track.x2`: `${= parent.width - 26}`); `drag.track.value` gives the value the node is drawn at in place of reading `variable`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | The variable the control sets. |
| `shape` | [DragTrackShape](#enum-DragTrackShape) | `"line"` | `line`, `arc`, `path` |  |
| `min` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `max` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `step` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `defaultValue` | double | unset |  | What a double tap resets to (bindable as `drag.track.defaultValue`). |
| `input` | [DragTrackInput](#enum-DragTrackInput) | `"follow"` | `follow`, `vertical`, `horizontal`, `both` |  |
| `pixelsPerRange` | double | `200` |  |  |
| `x1` | double | `0` |  | A line's ends, from the node's place (pixels, or with `relative` multiples of the node's size, with `units` parent of the parent's). |
| `y1` | double | `0` |  | A line's ends, from the node's place (pixels, or with `relative` multiples of the node's size, with `units` parent of the parent's). |
| `x2` | double | `0` |  | A line's ends, from the node's place (pixels, or with `relative` multiples of the node's size, with `units` parent of the parent's). |
| `y2` | double | `-100` |  | A line's ends, from the node's place (pixels, or with `relative` multiples of the node's size, with `units` parent of the parent's). |
| `startAngle` | double | `-135` |  | Degrees about the pivot. |
| `endAngle` | double | `135` |  | An arc's angles (degrees, clockwise, 0 up) about the pivot (from the node's center). |
| `pivotX` | double | `0` |  | An arc's angles (degrees, clockwise, 0 up) about the pivot (from the node's center). |
| `pivotY` | double | `0` |  | An arc's angles (degrees, clockwise, 0 up) about the pivot (from the node's center). |
| `rotate` | bool | `true` |  | Turns the node with the arc. |
| `path` | String | unset |  |  |
| `orientToPath` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `jumpOnTap` | bool | `false` |  | Pressing anywhere along the track (or the `hitArea`) moves the node there, then the drag goes on (only for `DragTrackInput.follow`). |

| `orientUpright` | bool | `false` |  | With `orientToPath`, never upside down (as `Motion.orientUpright`). |
| `detent` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | How magnetic the steps are while dragging (0–1). |
| `overscroll` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | How far past an end it stretches (0–1). |
| `settle` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | The glide to its value's place when not following the pointer (ms; 0 jumps), its curve, and the spring of `AnimationCurve.spring` (mass 1), which a release mid-fling starts at the pointer's speed. |
| `settleCurve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"easeOutCubic"` |  |  |
| `settleSpring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | `{}` |  | The spring of a `spring` `settleCurve` (JSON `settleSpring`; the legacy `settleStiffness`/`settleDamping` read as it). |
| `parkedProgress` | double | unset |  | Where it parks while the value is out of range or empty. |
| `keyboard` | bool | `true` |  | Takes keyboard focus: arrows step by `keyStep` (else `step`, else 1% of the range), Page Up/Down by 10 steps, Home and End to the ends. |

| `viewBoxHeight` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | With both above 0, `path` is drawn in the box of the frame the node sits in, in these units, stretched to the frame's size. |

| `wheelStep` | double | unset |  | One wheel notch, one arrow key (null: `step`, else 1% of the range). |
| `doubleTapValues` | List<double> | `[]` |  | Values a double tap moves between, in order (empty: `defaultValue`). |
| `keyStep` | double | unset |  | One wheel notch, one arrow key (null: `step`, else 1% of the range). |

| `write` | bool | `true` |  | Whether dragging writes `variable`; off, it only shows it and its reactions set what changes from `${result.value}`. |
| `endless` | bool | `false` |  | An arc that keeps turning past its ends, the value unbounded (a combination dial). |
| `momentum` | bool | `false` |  | Let go while moving, it coasts, slowing by `friction` per second, then settles on a `step`. |
| `friction` | double | `2.6` |  |  |

| `gain` | double | `1` |  | How far the node moves per pointer movement (0.5 fine, 2 coarse). |

<a id="type-Flight"></a>
### Flight

How a node with a `Behaviors.flightKey` flies in from where the node with the same key was: on a spring by default, or, with a `duration`, along a curve that rises `lift` (or `liftShare` of the distance, the larger) above the higher end, swelling to `swell` at the middle and spinning `turns` times (toward the way it flies), trailing `trail` fading dots.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | 0: on the node's spring. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"easeInOut"` |  |  |
| `lift` | double | `0` |  | Rise of the path's control point above the higher end (px). |
| `liftShare` | double | `0` |  | The same as a share of the distance flown (the larger wins). |
| `swell` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 | Scale at the middle of the flight. |
| `turns` | double | `0` |  | Turns over the flight, clockwise when flying right. |
| `trail` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Fading dots left behind. |
| `trailColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | `"#FFFFC83D"` |  |  |

<a id="type-FlipCard"></a>
### FlipCard

Makes the node a two-sided card (node key `flip`; a runtime 3D turn, not a mirror): its first child is the front, its second the back, turned 180° in advance; each hides while it faces away. The turn is the node's own `Motion` (rotateY, or rotateX for `FlipAxis.x`, 0 or 180), with its perspective, duration (600 ms without one), curve and keyframes. Inside the card `${flip.flipped}` and `${flip.progress}` (0 front, 1 back) can be read.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `axis` | [FlipAxis](#enum-FlipAxis) | `"y"` | `y`, `x` |  |
| `flipped` | bool | `false` |  | Whether the back shows. Bindable as `flip.flipped`. |
| `tapToFlip` | bool | `true` |  | A tap turns it over (and writes `variable`). |
| `dragToFlip` | bool | `false` |  | A drag across turns it with the finger; it settles on the nearer face (or follows a fling) on release. |
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | A boolean variable it follows and writes. |
| `spring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | `{}` |  | The spring it settles with after a drag. |

<a id="type-GesturePhysics"></a>
### GesturePhysics

How a node moves on its own once the pointer lets go, the same for a `DragMotion`, a `DragSource`'s return and a `TransformGesture`: a fling that slows by `friction` (Flutter's `FrictionSimulation`), a stretch of `overscroll` past the bounds, and a `spring` onto the `snap` target nearest to where the fling would stop. The legacy flat spring keys (`stiffness`, `damping`, `mass`, `bounce`, `duration`) read as `spring`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | `{}` |  | The spring it settles on. |
| `fling` | bool | `true` |  | Whether a release keeps the pointer's velocity and coasts. |
| `friction` | double | `0.865` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | The share of a fling's speed lost per second. |
| `minFlingVelocity` | double | `50` |  | Pixels per second: slower releases don't fling; the fastest start. |
| `maxFlingVelocity` | double | `8000` |  | Pixels per second: slower releases don't fling; the fastest start. |
| `overscroll` | double | `0.5` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | How far it stretches past its bounds (0 a hard stop, 1 free). |
| `snap` | [GestureSnap](#type-GestureSnap) | unset |  |  |

Dragging a list's items to a new place, within the list and, with a `group`, into other lists of the group (a Kanban board). A drop runs the list's `reorder` reactions with `${result.from}`, `${result.to}`, `${result.item}`, `${result.fromList}` and `${result.toList}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `start` | [ReorderStart](#enum-ReorderStart) | `"handle"` | `handle`, `longPress`, `press` |  |
| `group` | String | `""` |  | Lists of one group take each other's items; empty: within this list. |
| `listKey` | String | `""` |  | This list in `${result.fromList}` / `${result.toList}` (an expression); empty: the list's id. |
| `canReorderIf` | String | `""` |  | Must hold for an item (`${item}`, `${index}`) to be picked up. |
| `canDropIf` | String | `""` |  | Must hold for a drop (`${result}` as the drop would be). |
| `proxyElevation` | double | `6` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `proxyScale` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `proxyOpacity` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 |  |
| `placeholder` | [ReorderPlaceholder](#enum-ReorderPlaceholder) | `"gap"` | `gap`, `node` |  |
| `autoScroll` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `autoScrollEdge` | double | `48` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `keyboard` | bool | `true` |  | A focused item moves with Alt and the arrow keys, and is announced. |
| `apply` | [ListApply](#enum-ListApply) | `"none"` | `none`, `variable`, `cloud` |  |
| `orderField` | String | `"order"` |  | The numeric field of a document's position (`ListApply.cloud`). |
| `listField` | String | `""` |  | The field of the list a document is in, for moves between lists. |

Groups a data list's consecutive items with the same `groupBy` value into sections, each under the list's `sectionHeader` slot.

<a id="type-Measure"></a>
### Measure

Writes where the node is laid out, `{x, y, width, height, centerX, centerY}` in pixels, to a variable as layout changes: in the coordinates of the ancestor node `relativeTo` (empty: the screen), under `key` when the variable is a map. Other nodes then follow it: a marker travelling to the chip of the reader's layer on a timeline whose chips are laid out by data. The design canvas measures too.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | The variable its box is written to. |
| `key` | String | `""` |  | The key it's written under, for a map variable. |
| `relativeTo` | String | `""` |  | An ancestor node whose box it's measured in; empty: the screen. |

<a id="type-Motion"></a>
### Motion

How a node moves: a transform drawn over its layout (CSS-like: it doesn't move anything else), the transitions between its values when they change, an entrance, a loop and a spin. Its values are the node's rest pose; the design canvas draws the node there.

The transform, in order: `translateX`/`translateY` (pixels), `scale` times `scaleX`/`scaleY`, `rotate` (degrees, plus the spin), then `rotateX`/`rotateY` in 3D with `perspective`, about the point (`originX`, `originY`) in the box (-1–1, 0 the center); then a shift by `shiftX`/`shiftY` times the node's size. `opacity` and `blur` apply on top of the node's own.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `translateX` | double | `0` |  | Pixels. |
| `translateY` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `scale` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `scaleX` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `scaleY` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `shiftX` | double | `0` |  | Times the node's size. |
| `shiftY` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `opacity` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 |  |
| `rotate` | double | `0` |  | Degrees. |
| `rotateX` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `rotateY` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `spin` | double | `0` |  | Turns per second. |
| `pathProgress` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `blur` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `perspective` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `originX` | double | `0` |  | The transform's origin in the box (-1–1, 0 the center). |
| `originY` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `duration` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | A transition's length and its wait (ms). |
| `delay` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | A transition's length and its wait (ms). |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"easeInOut"` |  |  |
| `rotateCurve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | unset |  | The rotation's own curve; null follows `curve`. |
| `fadeShare` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | The share of the duration in which the opacity arrives (easing out). |
| `spring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | `{}` |  | The spring of the `spring` curve. |
| `spinRamp` | int | `800` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `loop` | [MotionLoop](#enum-MotionLoop) | `"none"` | `none`, `restart`, `reverse`, `swing` | Plays between the start (`enterFrom`, else rest) and the values. |
| `repeat` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Loop runs (0: forever). |
| `enter` | bool | `false` |  | Plays an entrance when the node appears: from `enterFrom`, or from rest to the values when null. |
| `enterFrom` | [Motion](#type-Motion) | unset |  |  |
| `replayKey` | String | unset |  | A change of this text replays the entrance. |
| `backfaceHidden` | bool | `false` |  | Hidden while its back faces the viewer. |
| `path` | String | unset |  | An SVG path the node moves along. |
| `orientToPath` | bool | `false` |  | Turns with the path's direction. |
| `keyframes` | List<[MotionKeyframe](#type-MotionKeyframe)> | `[]` |  |  |
| `revealOnScroll` | bool | `false` |  | Waits to enter until `revealFraction` of the node scrolls into view. |
| `enterHeld` | bool | `false` |  | Holds the entrance at its start while true (bindable). |
| `revealFraction` | double | `0.15` |  |  |
| `orientUpright` | bool | `false` |  | With `orientToPath`: never upside down. |
| `uprightMirror` | bool | `false` |  | With `orientUpright`: heading left mirrors the node, so its front leads. |
| `arc` | double | `0` |  | A change of position bends this share of its distance off the line. |
| `paused` | bool | `false` |  | Freezes the loop and the spin where they are. |
| `phase` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | Where the loop starts in its cycle (0–1). |
| `pathPacing` | [MotionPathPacing](#enum-MotionPathPacing) | `"length"` | `length`, `area` | How `pathProgress` maps to a point on `path`: by length or by area swept about (`pathFocusX`, `pathFocusY`). |
| `pathFocusX` | double | `0` |  | The focus of area pacing, in the path's coordinates. |
| `pathFocusY` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `pathWrap` | bool | `false` |  | Reads the progress modulo 1. |
| `pathViewBox` | List<double> | `[]` |  | The path's coordinate space `[width, height]`, stretched over the node's parent; empty: pixels. |
| `shimmer` | [MotionShimmer](#type-MotionShimmer) | unset |  | A band of light sweeping across the node; null for none. |

<a id="type-NodeAnimation"></a>
### NodeAnimation

One `AnimationController` on a node and the tweens it drives (behavior key `animations`, a list). A screen-wide one sits on the canvas node.

Its value runs 0 → 1 over `duration` (back over `reverseDuration`), after `delay`, eased by `curve` (`CurvedAnimation`), `repeat`ed or once; on a `spring` instead of the clock; or follows `progress` (an expression) with no clock at all. Each track maps that value to its property (`AnimationTrack`).

`preset` names a short form (`pulse`, `shake`, `spin`... see `AnimationPresets`) whose tracks and timing it stands for, with `params`; fields given here override the preset's (`expanded`).

Read as `${animation.<id>.value}` (after `curve`), `.status` (`dismissed`, `forward`, `reverse`, `completed`) and `.isAnimating` by the node and the nodes inside it; driven by the `animate` action.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | String | `""` |  | Unique on the node; what `animate` and `${animation.<id>}` name. |
| `preset` | String | unset |  | A short form (`AnimationPresets`); its params below. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Off, it applies nothing and doesn't run (the node shows its own values). Bindable. |
| `duration` | int | unset |  | Milliseconds; empty: the preset's, else 300. |
| `reverseDuration` | int | unset |  | `AnimationController.duration` / `reverseDuration` (ms); null: the preset's, else 300. |
| `delay` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Waits this long (ms) before each play starts; the value holds at its start meanwhile. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | unset |  | Applied to the controller's value before every track; null: the preset's, else linear. |
| `repeat` | [AnimationRepeat](#type-AnimationRepeat) | unset |  | `repeat(reverse:, count:)`; null: the preset's, else plays once. |
| `autoplay` | bool | unset |  | Plays when the node appears; false waits for `playKey` or an action. Null: the preset's, else true. |
| `playKey` | String | unset |  | A change plays it from the start (bindable). |
| `paused` | bool | `false` |  | Holds the controller where it is (`stop()`) while true; it carries on when false. Held before it starts, it waits at its start. Bindable. |
| `phase` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | Where a play starts in its cycle (0–1). |
| `spring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | unset |  | Runs on this spring instead of `duration` and `curve`: `animateWith(SpringSimulation(spring, 0, 1, 0))`. |
| `progress` | String | unset |  | An expression giving its value (0–1) instead of a clock. |
| `alignment` | [Alignment](#type-Alignment) | unset |  | The point the scale and rotation of its adding and multiplying tracks are about (`ScaleTransition(alignment:)`); null: the preset's, else the center. |
| `tracks` | List<[AnimationTrack](#type-AnimationTrack)> | `[]` |  |  |
| `previewAt` | double | unset |  | Where the design canvas draws it (a share of a cycle); empty: not applied there. |

<a id="type-ParticleEmitter"></a>
### ParticleEmitter

Confetti, stars or emoji the node bursts with on cue.

Each particle leaves from the origin at `speed` (55–115%) in a direction within `spread` of `direction`, slows by `drag`, falls by `gravity` no faster than `terminalVelocity`, sways `sway` px side to side, spins and turns over (`flutter`), and fades out over the last `fadeOut` ms of its `lifetime`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | int | `40` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `emit` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Over how long the particles leave (0: all at once). |
| `colors` | List<[Color](#type-Color)> | `["#FFFFC83D","#FFFF6F61","#FF2FD9A4","#FF8B6CFF","#FF3FB8...` |  |  |
| `shapes` | List<[ParticleShape](#enum-ParticleShape)> | `["square","strip","circle"]` | `square`, `circle`, `strip`, `star`, `image`, `triangle`, `squiggle`, `emoji` |  |
| `size` | double | `10` |  |  |
| `originX` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `originY` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `originWidth` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `direction` | double | `0` |  | Degrees. |
| `spread` | double | `60` |  |  |
| `speed` | double | `700` |  |  |
| `gravity` | double | `900` |  |  |
| `lifetime` | int | `2600` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `playOnAppear` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `delay` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Wait after the cue (ms). |
| `drag` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Speed lost per second, e^(-drag). |
| `terminalVelocity` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | The fastest fall (px/s; 0: no limit). |
| `sway` | double | `0` |  | Side-to-side sway (px). |
| `flutter` | double | `8` | ≥ 0 | Turning over in 3D (radians per second, up to). |
| `spin` | double | `515` |  | Spin (degrees per second, up to). |
| `fadeOut` | int | `500` | ≥ 0 | Fade out over the end of each particle's life (ms). |
| `mirror` | bool | `false` |  | Two cannons: every other particle mirrored across the middle. |
| `glyph` | String | `""` |  | The text emoji particles draw. |
| `image` | String | `""` |  | The image `image` particles draw (a URL). |

With `follow` it stays there while the content around it moves (lines added above an end marker, an image that loads late), until the user scrolls away: a chat or transcript pinned to its newest line.

| `velocity` | double | `700` |  | A fling faster than this (px/s) toward `direction` closes it. |
| `spring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | `{}` |  |  |

<a id="type-RouteTransition"></a>
### RouteTransition

A composable route transition. `enter` is where the incoming screen starts, `exit` where the covered one ends; closing plays them in reverse unless `popEnter` (where the screen revealed by the pop starts) or `popExit` (where the closing screen goes) are given. A `preset` fills in what's left null. JSON: an object, or a bare preset name.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | [RouteTransitionPreset](#enum-RouteTransitionPreset) | unset | `sharedAxisX`, `sharedAxisY`, `sharedAxisZ`, `fadeThrough`, `iosPush`, `iosModal`, `circularReveal`, `zoom`, `coverVertical`, `cube`, `flip` | A ready-made transition; the sides given override its own. |
| `enter` | [TransitionSide](#type-TransitionSide) | unset |  | Where the incoming screen starts. |
| `exit` | [TransitionSide](#type-TransitionSide) | unset |  | Where the covered screen ends. |
| `popEnter` | [TransitionSide](#type-TransitionSide) | unset |  | Null: exit reversed. |
| `popExit` | [TransitionSide](#type-TransitionSide) | unset |  | Null: enter reversed. |
| `durationMs` | int | unset |  | Null: the preset's (300). |
| `reverseDurationMs` | int | unset |  | Null: `durationMs`. |
| `barrierColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  | Drawn behind a modal (or a see-through page) while it's open. Null: none on pages, the dialog's own on modals. |
| `opaque` | bool | unset |  | Whether the screen hides the one below once open. Null: the preset's (true without one). |
| `swipeBack` | [RouteSwipeBack](#enum-RouteSwipeBack) | unset | `platform`, `always`, `never` | Null: the preset's (`RouteSwipeBack.platform` without one). |
| `dismiss` | [RouteDismiss](#type-RouteDismiss) | unset |  | A drag that closes the screen. |

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |

| `type` | [ShapeBorderType](#enum-ShapeBorderType) | `"roundedRectangle"` | `roundedRectangle`, `circle`, `stadium`, `continuousRectangle`, `beveledRectangle`, `roundedSuperellipse` |  |

<a id="type-Spring"></a>
### Spring

Flutter's `SpringDescription`: either the physical triple (`SpringDescription(mass:, stiffness:, damping:)`, when `stiffness` and `damping` are both given) or `SpringDescription.withDurationAndBounce` (`duration` ms, `bounce`). The one spring value of the model: transitions, animations, gestures, a flip card's settle and a route's dismiss all take it. JSON: `{"stiffness": 380, "damping": 36}` or `{"duration": 500, "bounce": 0.3}` (sparse; `{}` is `withDurationAndBounce()`'s defaults).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stiffness` | double | unset |  | The physical spring's constants; both null: `duration` and `bounce`. |
| `damping` | double | unset |  | The physical spring's constants; both null: `duration` and `bounce`. |
| `mass` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `duration` | int | `500` | ≥ 1 | `withDurationAndBounce`: ms, and 0 (none) to 1. |
| `bounce` | double | `0` |  |  |

### StateStyles

What a node and its descendants change to in each `WidgetState`: per state, node id → a patch of that node's JSON (a merge patch: maps merge, `null` removes, anything else replaces; see `mergePatch`). Later states in `WidgetState`'s order win where active states overlap.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hovered` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `focused` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `pressed` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `selected` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `disabled` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `dragged` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |

<a id="type-Sticky"></a>
### Sticky

Pins the node inside the scrolling row or column it scrolls in, as CSS `position: sticky`: once its leading edge reaches `offset` from the view's leading edge it stays there, drawn above the content scrolling under it, until the end of its parent (the section it heads) pushes it on. `${sticky.stuck}` says whether it is pinned now (the node's own bindings and the nodes inside it read it). The design canvas, which doesn't scroll, draws it in place. JSON `true` or `{"offset": 8}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `offset` | double | `0` |  | Distance from the view's leading edge where it pins (px). |

<a id="type-StrokePath"></a>
### StrokePath

A line drawn through `points` in the node's box (a dotted trail, a connector), behind its content or `inFront` of it. x and y are fractions of the box or pixels, per `xUnit`/`yUnit`.

With `drawMs` a running app draws the line along its length, like a pen (a map's passages inking in, a route tracing itself): over `drawMs` ms after `drawDelayMs`, eased by `drawCurve`, up to `progress`; when the node first shows, again from nothing when `drawKey` changes, and from where it is when `progress` changes. The design canvas draws it at `progress`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | List<[Offset](#type-Offset)> | `[]` |  | In the box: fractions or pixels per `xUnit` / `yUnit`. |
| `xUnit` | [PathUnit](#enum-PathUnit) | `"fraction"` | `fraction`, `pixels` |  |
| `yUnit` | [PathUnit](#enum-PathUnit) | `"pixels"` | `fraction`, `pixels` |  |
| `curve` | [PathCurve](#enum-PathCurve) | `"straight"` | `straight`, `vertical`, `horizontal`, `quadratic` | The shape the points enclose (the path closed), filled behind the line: a hand-drawn box with its own wobble. It fades in as the line draws (its alpha times `progress`). Null: no fill. |
| `color` | [Color](#type-Color) | `"#FFFFFFFF"` |  |  |
| `width` | double | `4` |  |  |
| `progress` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | Fraction of the stroke drawn along its length. |
| `dashPattern` | List<double> | `[]` |  | Dash and gap lengths, alternating; empty is solid. |
| `cap` | [StrokeCap](#enum-StrokeCap) | `"round"` | `butt`, `round`, `square` |  |
| `inFront` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `drawMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Draw-on time (ms) in a running app; 0 shows it at once. |
| `drawDelayMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Wait (ms) before drawing. |
| `drawCurve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"easeInOut"` |  | How the drawing eases. |
| `drawKey` | String | `""` |  | Draws again from nothing when it changes. |
| `fillColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  | Fills the shape the points enclose, behind the line (fading in as it draws). |
| `untilWidth` | bool | `false` |  | Draws only the segments that start within the box width (a long ruled line fits any width). |

<a id="type-Tilt"></a>
### Tilt

Tilts the node in 3D toward the pointer while it hovers or drags over it. `max` holds the `Motion` values reached with the pointer at an edge: the edge under it tips away (rotateX at the top and bottom, rotateY at the sides, with its perspective); scale and translate are reached while the pointer is over the node at all. Inside it `${tilt.x}`, `${tilt.y}` (-1–1) can be read, for parallax.

| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"easeOutCubic"` |  |  |

<a id="type-TransformGesture"></a>
### TransformGesture

Makes the node pannable, zoomable and rotatable by touch, mouse and trackpad (Flutter's `InteractiveViewer`, and more): pinch and ctrl+wheel zoom about the focal point, one finger pans, two rotate, a double tap zooms to a point; a release flings and settles by `physics` within `bounds` and `minScale`–`maxScale`. The pose binds two-way to variables (`xVariable`...); inside it reads as `${transform.x}`, `${transform.scale}`... Each change runs the node's `changed` reactions, the end of a gesture its `changeEnd` ones.

`Behaviors.zoomable` is its first form: `zoomable`.

| `rotate` | bool | `false` |  | Whether pinch, wheel and double tap zoom; two fingers rotate. |

| `wheel` | [WheelZoom](#enum-WheelZoom) | `"ctrlZoom"` | `none`, `ctrlZoom`, `zoom`, `pan` |  |
| `rotationSnap` | double | `0` |  | Degrees; 0 is free. |
| `physics` | [GesturePhysics](#type-GesturePhysics) | unset |  | Null for `GesturePhysics.standard`. |
| `xVariable` | String | `""` |  | Number variables holding the pose, two-way (a zoom slider). |
| `yVariable` | String | `""` |  | Number variables holding the pose, two-way (a zoom slider). |

<a id="type-Typewriter"></a>
### Typewriter

Text that types itself out in a running app, like a typewriter or a terminal: `charsPerSecond` characters a second after `delayMs`, with a blinking block `caret` after the last one while it types. It types when the text first shows and again from the start when `playKey` changes; when the text grows by appending (a streamed reply) only the new characters type, and when it changes otherwise it types afresh. `skip` (bindable, e.g. to a tap that sets a variable) shows the rest at once; off `enabled` it shows all of it. The layout never changes as it types: the whole text is laid out and only what's typed is painted. The design canvas shows it all.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Off, the whole text shows. |
| `charsPerSecond` | double | `40` | ≥ 0 | Typing speed. |
| `delayMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Wait (ms) before the first character. |
| `caret` | bool | `true` |  | A blinking block after the last character while it types. |
| `caretColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  | Null uses the text color. |
| `caretWidth` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | 0 is about half the font size. |
| `caretHeight` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Centered on the text's middle; 0 is about three quarters of the line. |
| `caretGap` | double | `1` |  | Space between the last character and the caret. |
| `caretAlignStyle` | [TextStyle](#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  | With a caret height: the style whose middle it centers on (empty: the text's). |
| `blinkMs` | int | `500` | ≥ 1 | How long the caret stays on, and off. |
| `skip` | bool | `false` |  | Shows the rest at once. |
| `playKey` | String | `""` |  | Types again from the start when it changes. |
| `holdAtMs` | int | unset |  | Stops the typing clock this many ms in (delay included): a part-typed still. Null types to the end. |
| `grow` | bool | `false` |  | Only as tall as the lines typed so far (off: the whole text's size from the start). |

<a id="type-ViewProgress"></a>
### ViewProgress

How far the node has scrolled through the viewport of the scrolling row or column (or list) it is in, as `${view.progress}` (0–1) and `${view.visible}` for its own bindings and the nodes inside it: a figure that draws itself as it scrolls up the screen (a path's `trimEnd`), a heading that fades in, a gauge reading how far through a section the reader is. Positions are fractions of the viewport's extent from its leading edge (0 top, 1 bottom), plus `offset` pixels. With `variable`, the progress is also written to that screen (or app) variable, under `key` when it's a map, for nodes elsewhere to read. The design canvas reads progress 0 above the fold and 1 for a node it shows whole.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | [ViewProgressMode](#enum-ViewProgressMode) | `"travel"` | `travel`, `pass` |  |
| `from` | double | `1` |  | Where progress is 0 (travel) or where the line is (pass): a fraction of the viewport from its leading edge. |
| `to` | double | `0` |  | Where progress is 1 (travel). |
| `offset` | double | `0` |  | Pixels added to both. |
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | A variable the progress is written to. |
| `key` | String | `""` |  | The key it's written under, for a map variable. |

<a id="type-Wave"></a>
### Wave

A sine added to a track's value: `amplitude * sin(2π(cycles·t + phase))`, fading by `1 − decay·t` (a shake dies out with decay 1), folded to its absolute value with `rectify` (a ball's hops). Flutter has no counterpart; a list of them is a Fourier series: a wobble, a sway, a flame's flicker.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cycles` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `amplitude` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `phase` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `decay` | double | `0` |  |  |

## Enums

Written as the value's name, a JSON string (`"center"`).

<a id="enum-AnimateCommand"></a>
### AnimateCommand

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `forward` | `forward(from:)`: plays to the end; on a variable, carries on toward `AnimateAction.target` (from where it is, or from `AnimateAction.from`). |
| `reverse` | `reverse(from:)`: plays back to the start. |
| `toggle` | Forward when at (or heading to) the start, else back. |
| `repeat` | `repeat()`, as the animation's own `NodeAnimation.repeat` says (forever when it says nothing). |
| `stop` | `stop()`: holds where it is. |
| `reset` | `reset()`: back to the start, stopped. |
| `animateTo` | `animateTo(target)`: from where it is to `AnimateAction.target` (0–1; on a variable, any number) over `AnimateAction.duration`. |
| `animateBack` | `animateBack(target)`. |
| `set` | `value = target`: jumps there; a running animation carries on from it. |

| `centered` | How a series chart places its grid lines (and solid reference lines). `centered`: centred on the value's rounded y (the bottom line one pixel row up, inside the plot); a 1 px line there straddles two pixel rows. `crisp` (the default): whole pixel rows from the value's rounded y down (the bottom line's up, inside the plot), so a line of whole width is sharp; other widths stay centred on the value. `exact`: the rows just above the value's unrounded y, like a Flutter box of that height whose bottom edge sits at the value (sharp when that is a whole pixel, soft otherwise). |
| `crisp` | How a series chart places its grid lines (and solid reference lines). `centered`: centred on the value's rounded y (the bottom line one pixel row up, inside the plot); a 1 px line there straddles two pixel rows. `crisp` (the default): whole pixel rows from the value's rounded y down (the bottom line's up, inside the plot), so a line of whole width is sharp; other widths stay centred on the value. `exact`: the rows just above the value's unrounded y, like a Flutter box of that height whose bottom edge sits at the value (sharp when that is a whole pixel, soft otherwise). |
| `exact` | How a series chart places its grid lines (and solid reference lines). `centered`: centred on the value's rounded y (the bottom line one pixel row up, inside the plot); a 1 px line there straddles two pixel rows. `crisp` (the default): whole pixel rows from the value's rounded y down (the bottom line's up, inside the plot), so a line of whole width is sharp; other widths stay centred on the value. `exact`: the rows just above the value's unrounded y, like a Flutter box of that height whose bottom edge sits at the value (sharp when that is a whole pixel, soft otherwise). |

| `containerTransform` | Material container transform: a card grows into a whole screen (tag the card and the destination's root the same); the card fades out over the first 30%. |

<a id="enum-RouteTransitionPreset"></a>

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `sharedAxisX` | Material shared axis X: both screens slide 30 px sideways, the old one fading out over the first 30% while the new one fades in. |
| `sharedAxisY` | Material shared axis Y: the same, vertically. |
| `sharedAxisZ` | Material shared axis Z: the new screen grows in from 80% while the old one grows to 110% and fades. |
| `fadeThrough` | Material fade through: the old screen fades out, then the new one fades in while it grows from 92%. |
| `iosPush` | iOS push: the new screen slides in from the right over the old one, which moves a third of the way left. Swipe from the left edge to go back. |
| `iosModal` | iOS modal sheet: the new screen slides up over the old one, which shrinks back a little. Drag down to dismiss. |
| `circularReveal` | The new screen is revealed by a circle growing from the tapped node. |
| `zoom` | The new screen zooms in from 85% while the old one zooms past and fades. |
| `coverVertical` | The new screen slides up from the bottom and covers the old one. |
| `cube` | The screens turn like two faces of a cube. |
| `flip` | The old screen turns over and the new one is its back face. |

<a id="page-behaviors"></a>
# Behaviors

Behaviors are what a node does beyond its layout and paint: motion, interaction states, tooltips, drag and drop,
scroll effects. Each is a key written directly on the node (not under `props`), sparse: leave it out for none. The
guide's [states](#guide-states) section shows `states`, the most used one.

## Keys

<a id="behavior-motion"></a>
<a id="behavior-scale"></a>
<a id="behavior-animations"></a>
<a id="behavior-transitions"></a>
<a id="behavior-inkWell"></a>
<a id="behavior-states"></a>
<a id="behavior-tooltip"></a>
<a id="behavior-ignorePointer"></a>
<a id="behavior-zoomable"></a>
<a id="behavior-floating"></a>
<a id="behavior-hero"></a>
<a id="behavior-flightKey"></a>
<a id="behavior-flight"></a>
<a id="behavior-draggable"></a>
<a id="behavior-dropTarget"></a>
<a id="behavior-drag"></a>
<a id="behavior-reveal"></a>
<a id="behavior-strokePath"></a>
<a id="behavior-typewriter"></a>
<a id="behavior-particles"></a>
<a id="behavior-textDirection"></a>
<a id="behavior-flip"></a>
<a id="behavior-tilt"></a>
<a id="behavior-transformGesture"></a>
<a id="behavior-sticky"></a>
<a id="behavior-viewProgress"></a>
<a id="behavior-measure"></a>
<a id="behavior-customPaint"></a>
| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `motion` | [Motion](#type-Motion) | unset |  | The transform over the layout, its transitions, entrance and spin. |
| `scale` | double | `1` | ≥ 0 | Drawn at this size around its center; layout unchanged (Flutter's `Transform.scale`). Bindable as `scale`. |
| `animations` | List<[NodeAnimation](#type-NodeAnimation)> | `[]` |  | Its animation controllers (the legacy `loops` and `effectAnimations` read as these). |
| `transitions` | [Transitions](#type-Transitions) | `{}` |  |  |
| `inkWell` | [InkWellStyle](#type-InkWellStyle) | unset |  | Ink: ripples, and hover/focus/press overlays. |
| `states` | [StateStyles](#type-StateStyles) | `{}` |  | Property overrides per interaction state. |
| `tooltip` | String | `""` |  | Shown on hover or long press; may hold `${...}` data. |
| `ignorePointer` | bool | `false` |  | Lets pointer events through to what's under the node (Flutter's `IgnorePointer`). |
| `zoomable` | bool | `false` |  | Pinch, scroll and double-tap zoom and pan (Flutter's `InteractiveViewer`). |
| `floating` | bool | `false` |  | Drawn above everything else at runtime (a menu under a field), still taking its place in the layout. The design canvas draws it in place. |
| `hero` | [HeroTag](#type-HeroTag) | unset |  |  |
| `flightKey` | String | `""` |  | Flies the node in from where the node with the same key just was. |
| `flight` | [Flight](#type-Flight) | unset |  | How it flies there (`flightKey`); null flies on the node's spring. |
| `draggable` | [DragSource](#type-DragSource) | unset |  |  |
| `dropTarget` | [DropTarget](#type-DropTarget) | unset |  |  |
| `drag` | [DragMotion](#type-DragMotion) | unset |  |  |
| `reveal` | [Reveal](#type-Reveal) | unset |  |  |
| `strokePath` | [StrokePath](#type-StrokePath) | unset |  |  |
| `typewriter` | [Typewriter](#type-Typewriter) | unset |  | A text that types itself out in a running app. |
| `particles` | [ParticleEmitter](#type-ParticleEmitter) | unset |  |  |
| `textDirection` | [TextDirection](#enum-TextDirection) | unset | `ltr`, `rtl` | Null inherits. |
| `flip` | [FlipCard](#type-FlipCard) | unset |  | A two-sided card that turns over (a runtime 3D turn, not a mirror). |
| `tilt` | [Tilt](#type-Tilt) | unset |  | Tilts in 3D toward the pointer. |
| `transformGesture` | [TransformGesture](#type-TransformGesture) | unset |  | Pinch, pan and rotate, with fling physics and optional handles (over `zoomable`: see `effectiveTransformGesture`). |
| `sticky` | [Sticky](#type-Sticky) | unset |  | Pinned in its scrolling view while its parent is in view. |
| `viewProgress` | [ViewProgress](#type-ViewProgress) | unset |  | `${view.progress}` through the viewport. |
| `measure` | [Measure](#type-Measure) | unset |  | Its laid-out box, written to a variable. |
| `customPaint` | [CustomPaint](#type-CustomPaint) | unset |  | Flutter's `CustomPaint`: draw lists behind and over the content. |

The models these keys hold (and the models inside them) are in [Value types, models and enums](#page-values): [Motion](#type-Motion), [NodeAnimation](#type-NodeAnimation), [Transitions](#type-Transitions), [InkWellStyle](#type-InkWellStyle), [StateStyles](#type-StateStyles), [HeroTag](#type-HeroTag), [Flight](#type-Flight), [DragSource](#type-DragSource), [DropTarget](#type-DropTarget), [DragMotion](#type-DragMotion), [Reveal](#type-Reveal), [StrokePath](#type-StrokePath), [Typewriter](#type-Typewriter), [ParticleEmitter](#type-ParticleEmitter), [FlipCard](#type-FlipCard), [Tilt](#type-Tilt), [TransformGesture](#type-TransformGesture), [Sticky](#type-Sticky), [ViewProgress](#type-ViewProgress), [Measure](#type-Measure), [CustomPaint](#type-CustomPaint).

<a id="page-triggers"></a>
# Triggers

A reaction (`"actions": [{"trigger": {...}, "actions": [...]}]` on a node) starts on its trigger. In the chain,
`${result}` first holds the trigger's event (where a click landed, an input's new value). Screen triggers (`load`,
`valueChanged`, `timer`, `keyDown`...) are set on the canvas.

## Trigger types

### On a node: pointer

| type | When |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-click"></a>`click` | A tap (a click with a mouse). `${result}` holds where it landed (`x`, `y` in the node, `globalX`, `globalY`) and the modifier keys held (`meta`, `shift`, `alt`). |
| <a id="trigger-doubleTap"></a>`doubleTap` | Two taps in quick succession. A node with double tap reactions waits out the double tap timeout before its single taps run. |
| <a id="trigger-longPress"></a>`longPress` | A long press. |
| <a id="trigger-hold"></a>`hold` | A press held for `Trigger.holdMs`; letting go early cancels it. |
| <a id="trigger-secondaryClick"></a>`secondaryClick` | A right click, or a two-finger tap on a trackpad (`${result.x}`, `${result.y}`: where, on screen). |
| <a id="trigger-pointerDown"></a>`pointerDown` | A pointer went down on the node. |
| <a id="trigger-pointerUp"></a>`pointerUp` | A pointer went up (or was canceled) on the node. |
| <a id="trigger-hover"></a>`hover` | The mouse cursor moved over the node (fires when it enters, too). |
| <a id="trigger-cursorEnter"></a>`cursorEnter` | The mouse cursor entered the node (once). |
| <a id="trigger-cursorExit"></a>`cursorExit` | The mouse cursor left the node (once). |
| <a id="trigger-swipeLeft"></a>`swipeLeft` | A swipe (a fling) to the left, right, up or down. |
| <a id="trigger-swipeRight"></a>`swipeRight` |  |
| <a id="trigger-swipeUp"></a>`swipeUp` |  |
| <a id="trigger-swipeDown"></a>`swipeDown` |  |
| <a id="trigger-drag"></a>`drag` | The node is dragged (every move); `dragEnd` when it's let go. |
| <a id="trigger-dragEnd"></a>`dragEnd` |  |
| <a id="trigger-wheel"></a>`wheel` | Wheel or trackpad scroll over the node; a pinch on it. |
| <a id="trigger-pinch"></a>`pinch` |  |

### On an input

| type | When |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-changed"></a>`changed` | An input's value changed (typed text, a toggled checkbox, a slider step, a picked item). `${result}` is the new value (a text field's: its text, word and selection). |

The screen stays and these actions run instead, e.g. a "Discard changes?" confirm that leaves with a navigate pop, which the block doesn't stop. While `blockBack` is false, back leaves as usual and this doesn't fire. |

A frame that comes while the chain still runs is skipped; its time goes to the next `dt`. A design canvas never ticks. |
| <a id="trigger-keyDown"></a>`keyDown` | A key went down (or up) while the screen shows; `Trigger.key` limits it to one key or combination, `Trigger.when` to while a formula holds. `${result.key}`, `${result.shift}`, `${result.alt}`, `${result.meta}`. |
| <a id="trigger-keyUp"></a>`keyUp` |  |

A list with a `reorder` fires `dragStart` when a row is picked up and `dragCompleted` when it is let go (moved or not), with `${result.index}` and `${result.item}`: a list can change while a row is lifted (fold its rows into tiles). On a node with a `drag` reaction (and no drag and drop), `dragStart` is the start of that one-finger drag, where the finger went down (`${drag.x}`, `${drag.y}`): begin a stroke there rather than on `pointerDown`, which fires for every finger of a pinch. |

| <a id="trigger-reorder"></a>`reorder` | A data list row was dragged to a new place by this node, its reorder handle (`${result.from}`, `${result.to}`). A list with a `reorder` fires it too, with `${result.item}`, `${result.fromList}`, `${result.toList}`. |

## Trigger fields

A trigger is `{"type": "<type>", ...these}`, or just the type as a string (`"click"`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | [TriggerType](#enum-TriggerType) | `"click"` |  |  |
| `debounceMs` | int | `0` |  | Waits this long after the last trigger before running, so a burst (typing in a search field) runs once. 0 runs every time. |
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | `TriggerType.valueChanged`: the variable watched. |
| `intervalMs` | int | `1000` |  | Timer: ms between ticks (a number or an expression). |
| `key` | String | `""` |  | Key triggers: the key or combination (`KeyCombo`); empty: any key. |
| `when` | String | `""` |  | A formula; the reaction runs only while it's true (key triggers take the key only then; a timer or a frame ticker runs only then). Empty: always. |
| `holdMs` | int | `1200` |  | `TriggerType.hold`: how long the press is held. |
| `visibleFraction` | double | `0.15` |  | Viewport triggers: the visible share (0–1) that counts as in view. |
| `repeat` | bool | `false` |  | keyDown: also while the key repeats. |
| `visibleMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Viewport: how long it stays in view before firing (ms). |
| `onceKey` | String | `""` |  | Runs once per key (an expression, such as ${item.id}) per app session. |

<a id="page-actions"></a>
# Actions

An action is a JSON object `{"type": "<type>", ...fields}`, run in order in a reaction's chain. Text fields are
expressions (`"${count}"`, `"${= a + 1}"`). A field holding nested actions (`then`, `else`, `onSuccess`...) is a
list of actions. A key not listed for the type is dropped by decoding and reported by validation
(`unknown_action_key`).

## Fields every action has

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | False skips the action. |
| `nonBlocking` | bool | `false` |  | The chain doesn't wait for it, and its failure doesn't stop the chain. |
| `when` | Object | unset |  | Runs only when it holds. |

Fields holding nested action chains (a list of actions): `then`, `else`, `actions`, `onSuccess`, `onError`, `cancelActions`.

<a id="action-navigate"></a>
## `navigate`: Navigate

Goes to another screen. JSON: `{"type": "navigate", "mode": "push", "to": "canvas-b", "params": {"id": "${item.id}"}}`. The destination reads `params` as `${route.<name>}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | [NavigationMode](#enum-NavigationMode) | `"push"` | `push`, `pop`, `replace`, `reset` |  |
| `to` | String | `""` |  | A screen (canvas) or layout id. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | Values the destination reads as ${route.<name>}. |
| `base` | String | `""` |  | `NavigationMode.reset`: a screen to put under the destination, so going back from it lands there. |
| `baseParams` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `transition` | [PageTransition](#enum-PageTransition) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `none`, `fade`, `fadeUp`, `slideUp`, `slideLeft`, `scale` |  |
| `transitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `reverseTransitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](#type-RouteTransition) | unset |  | A custom transition; replaces transition and its times. |

<a id="action-loadCloudData"></a>
## `loadCloudData`: Load cloud data

Streams a cloud document, or a collection query's documents, into variable `variable` while the screen shows: `{status: loading|loaded| error, isLoading, data, error, hasMore}`. A variable of type list gets the documents themselves, and with an `aggregate`, a number variable the number. Blocking actions wait for the first value; an initial failure stops the chain. A later subscription failure stops any remaining actions from that invocation and fires the canvas's actionError reaction. Subscriptions close on error or when the screen is disposed.

One variable has one live load: running the action again (or a `ReloadCloudDataAction`) replaces the earlier subscription. Unless `reactive` is false, the load runs again by itself when a value its query reads changes (`${auth.uid}`, `${search}`, a `limit` bound to a variable), but never for a change of its own variable.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `single` | bool | `true` |  | One document, or the query's documents. |
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `query` | Object | unset |  | The collection and, for a query, its filters, sorts, limit and joins (a CloudQueryDef). |
| `scope` | [CloudDataScope](#enum-CloudDataScope) | `"screen"` | `screen`, `app` | Screen: a subscription per screen, until it goes. App: one subscription the whole app shares, into an app variable every screen reads. |
| `limit` | String | `""` |  | The most documents: a number or expression; empty: the query's, else 500; 0: all. |
| `aggregate` | [CloudLoadAggregate](#enum-CloudLoadAggregate) | `"none"` | `none`, `count`, `sum`, `average` | A number (count, sum, average) instead of the documents, without loading them. |
| `aggregateField` | String | `""` |  | Sum and average: the field. |
| `refreshSeconds` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Aggregate: also runs again this often (writes made elsewhere); 0: after this app's writes only. |
| `reactive` | bool | `true` |  | Runs again when a value its query reads changes (${auth.uid}, a bound limit). |

<a id="action-reloadCloudData"></a>
## `reloadCloudData`: Reload cloud data

Runs again the live load of `variable` (a `LoadCloudDataAction` that ran on this screen): it subscribes afresh, with the values its query reads now, and waits for the first value. Nothing when the variable has no load. A list's pull to refresh (its `refresh` reaction) runs it.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | A variable a load cloud data action fills. |

<a id="action-cloudFiles"></a>
## `cloudFiles`: Cloud files

Uploads files the user picks to (or deletes them from) cloud storage folder `path`; `actions` run with each file (`${result.url}`...). With a `source`, it uploads that value instead of asking the user (a captured screenshot, a drawing).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudFilesOperation](#enum-CloudFilesOperation) | `"upload"` | `upload`, `delete` |  |
| `path` | String | `""` |  | The storage folder. |
| `kind` | [CloudFileKind](#enum-CloudFileKind) | `"image"` | `image`, `any` |  |
| `allowMultiple` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `maxSizeMB` | double | `10` |  |  |
| `progressVariable` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `access` | [CloudFileAccess](#enum-CloudFileAccess) | `"public"` | `public`, `private` |  |
| `source` | String | `""` |  | Uploads this instead of asking the user: a data: URL (${result.image} of a screenshot), or a list. |
| `fileName` | String | `""` |  | The name a source file is stored under. |
| `actions` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run with each file. |

<a id="action-cloudData"></a>
## `cloudData`: Cloud data

Creates, updates, deletes, reads, queries or aggregates documents of a collection. Its result (the new id, the document, the documents, the number) is the chain's `${result}` and goes in `resultVariable`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudDataOperation](#enum-CloudDataOperation) | `"create"` | `create`, `update`, `delete`, `get`, `query`, `count`, `sum`, `average` |  |
| `collection` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `fields` | Object | unset |  | Field writes: [{"field", "value", "operation"}]. |
| `whereFilters` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `orderByFilters` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `limit` | int | unset |  |  |
| `aggregateField` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `loadRelated` | List<String> | `[]` |  |  |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  |  |

<a id="action-cloudBatch"></a>
## `cloudBatch`: Cloud batch

Several `CloudDataAction` writes (create, update, delete) committed at once. With `forEach`, `steps` run once per item of that list (`${loop.item}`, `${loop.index}`), every write in the same commit: "mark all read" in one write instead of one per item.

Up to `kMaxCloudBatchWrites` writes are all or none. More are committed in chunks of that size, each all or none; with `transaction`, more fail before anything is written. A batch with a read step (get, query, count, sum, average) runs its steps one by one, as before.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | Object | unset |  | Nested cloudData actions. |
| `transaction` | bool | `false` |  | All or none: more than 500 writes fail instead of committing in chunks. |
| `forEach` | String | `""` |  | A list: the steps run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}), all in one commit. |

<a id="action-submitForm"></a>
## `submitForm`: Submit form

Validates a form's answers and stores them in the app's own variables (`service: local`). See `docs/submit_form.md`.

A remote destination is an explicit later action (`callApi` in `onSuccess`) to an endpoint the app defines; this action itself never calls a service.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | [FormService](#enum-FormService) | `"local"` | `local` | Only `local` is offered: `FormService.unsupported` marks old data. |
| `payload` | String | `""` |  | An expression yielding a JSON object. |
| `validationScript` | String | `""` |  | Await a script returning {valid, errors?, payload?}. |
| `validationArguments` | Object | unset |  | Named script argument expressions. |
| `responseVariable` | String | `""` |  | Optional mutable list variable receiving the validated payload. Persist the variable to keep submissions. |
| `prepend` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  | An expression yielding a JSON object. An awaited validator may replace it with its normalized `payload`. |
| `onSuccess` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  |  |

<a id="action-auth"></a>
## `auth`: Auth

Signs app users in, up and out, and manages their account. A failure's message goes in `errorVariable` (and stops the chain).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [AuthOperation](#enum-AuthOperation) | `"signIn"` |  |  |
| `email` | String | `""` |  |  |

| `displayName` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `photoUrl` | String | `""` |  |  |

| `errorVariable` | String | `""` |  | Gets a failure's message. |

<a id="action-paywall"></a>
## `paywall`: Paywall

A paywall interaction: buy the selected (or `slot`'s) product, restore purchases, select a product, close the paywall, open a legal `url`, or open a server-resolved `placement`.

`PaywallOperation.openPaywall` shows the placement's screen as a navigation would: with `routeTransition` (a custom transition: a cover from the bottom, a reveal...) or `transition`, `transitionMs` and `reverseTransitionMs`; it plays in reverse when the paywall closes.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [PaywallOperation](#enum-PaywallOperation) | `"purchase"` | `purchase`, `restore`, `selectProduct`, `closePaywall`, `openLegalLink`, `openPaywall` |  |
| `placement` | String | unset |  | The server-resolved placement to open. |
| `offer` | String | unset |  | storeDefault, trial, or standard; expressions allowed. |
| `slot` | String | unset |  |  |
| `url` | String | unset |  | A legal link. |
| `transition` | [PageTransition](#enum-PageTransition) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `none`, `fade`, `fadeUp`, `slideUp`, `slideLeft`, `scale` | openPaywall: how its screen opens. |
| `transitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `reverseTransitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](#type-RouteTransition) | unset |  | openPaywall: a custom transition for its screen; replaces transition and its times. |

<a id="action-print"></a>
## `print`: Print

Requests the platform print dialog for a rendered node. The user chooses the destination and confirms; this action never silently submits a job.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  | A rendered node to print through a user-confirmed platform dialog. |

<a id="action-preloadImages"></a>
## `preloadImages`: Preload images

Loads images ahead of showing them (a story's pages before reading), so they draw at once: `urls` is an expression giving a list of URLs (or a comma-separated text). While it runs, `progressVariable` (a variable's name; empty for none) holds the share done (0–1). It waits for every image and gives `{loaded, failed, total}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `urls` | String | `""` |  | The image URLs: a list (an expression) or comma-separated text. |
| `progressVariable` | String | `""` |  | A variable to hold the share loaded (0-1) while it runs. |

<a id="action-speak"></a>
## `speak`: Speak

Reads `text` aloud, or `stop`s speaking. `rate` and `pitch` are numbers or expressions.

With `readAlong` the words are timed for a read-along highlight (`speech.wordIndex`): the text is said a phrase at a time, each word gets time by its syllables from the moment its phrase starts sounding, and the voice's word boundaries (when it reports them) snap the highlight to the real word and set the pace; without a voice the words are read along silently at that pace. It starts at `startWord` and the action waits until the text has been said (its result: `{completed: bool}`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `language` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `rate` | String | `"1"` |  | A number or expression. |
| `pitch` | String | `""` |  | A number or expression. |
| `stop` | bool | `false` |  | Stops speaking. |
| `readAlong` | bool | `false` |  | Times every word (speech.wordIndex) even when the voice reports no word boundaries, and reads along silently without a voice; the action waits until the text is said. |
| `startWord` | String | `""` |  | Read along: the word to start at (an index or expression), to carry on after a pause. |

<a id="action-playSound"></a>
## `playSound`: Play sound

Plays a synthesised `sound` (a voice name), now or `at` a time on the sound clock, or the sound file at `url`. Every field is an expression.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sound` | String | `"wood"` |  | A synthesised voice name. |
| `operation` | String | `"play"` |  | play, start, stop, or stopAll. |
| `voiceId` | String | `""` |  | The independently owned sustained voice. |
| `frequency` | String | `"440"` |  | Sustained tone frequency in hertz. |
| `waveform` | String | `"sine"` |  | Sustained voice: sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, felt, reed or pluck. |
| `note` | String | `""` |  | A MIDI note number (60 = middle C) in place of frequency. |
| `duration` | String | `""` |  | Milliseconds until a started voice releases itself; empty sustains. |
| `volume` | String | `"1"` |  |  |
| `pitch` | String | `"1"` |  |  |
| `at` | String | `""` |  | A time on the sound clock. |
| `url` | String | `""` |  | A sound file. |

<a id="action-captureScreenshot"></a>
## `captureScreenshot`: Capture screenshot

Captures what is on screen as a PNG image. `${result}` is `{"image": "data:image/png;base64,...", "width", "height"}` (in pixels): bind it to an image fill to show it, or upload it with a `cloudFiles` action whose `source` is `${result.image}`. JSON: `{"type": "captureScreenshot", "target": "app"}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | [CaptureTarget](#enum-CaptureTarget) | `"layout"` | `layout`, `node`, `app` | The screen, one of its nodes, or the whole app (in the host's capture scope). |
| `node` | String | `""` |  | The node captured (target node). |
| `pixelRatio` | double | `0` |  | Pixels per logical pixel; 0: the device's. |

<a id="action-downloadFile"></a>
## `downloadFile`: Download file

Exports generated UTF-8 text (CSV, JSON, plain text...) as a file. The browser downloads it; native apps show the platform save picker. Cancellation returns `{saved: false}` as the action result.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fileName` | String | `"export.txt"` |  | Suggested filename, an expression. |
| `text` | String | `""` |  | Generated file contents as UTF-8 text. |
| `mimeType` | String | `"text/plain"` |  |  |

<a id="action-emitEvent"></a>
## `emitEvent`: Emit event

Fires app event `event` with `props` (text values are expressions) on the app's event bus: the project's automations listening for it run (a popup after the third order), and the host app hears it (`codelessly.events`). The same bus a host fires with `codelessly.emit(name, props)`. JSON: `{"type": "emitEvent", "event": "onboarding_done", "props": {"plan": "${plan}"}}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | String | `""` |  | The app event's name (an expression). |
| `props` | Object | unset |  | Its properties; text values are expressions. |

<a id="page-bindings"></a>
# Bindings and expressions

`"bind"` on a node maps a **binding path** (a path into the node's JSON) to an expression; the field at the path
takes the expression's value. Paths: `visible`, `opacity`, `layout.<field>`, `decoration.<field>` (with
`[index]`, a paint's `id` or `*` into lists), `props.<prop>` and deeper fields of model props, `data`, `selected`,
`disabled`, and the behavior keys. Values are read loosely: `"12"` is a number, `1` and `"true"` are true,
`"#FF0000"` is a color; a value that cannot be read leaves the field as it was.

Expressions: `${path}` reads a value (`user.name`, `items[0].price`, `pal[item.kind]`), `${= formula}` computes
one ([formula functions](#page-formulas)). A binding that is exactly one expression keeps the value's type.

## Named paths

| Path | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `visible` |  |
| `opacity` |  |
| `selected` | Interaction states driven by data: true puts the node in `WidgetState.selected` / `WidgetState.disabled`, so its state styles (`states.selected`, `states.disabled`) patch it and its descendants, as hover and press do (`"selected": "${= item.id == selectedId}"`). |
| `disabled` |  |
| `data` | The items a repeating widget (list, grid, page view) builds one per. |
| `layout.width` |  |
| `layout.height` |  |
| `layout.flex` |  |
| `layout.rotation` |  |
| `layout.margin` |  |
| `layout.padding` |  |
| `layout.x` |  |
| `layout.y` |  |
| `decoration.radius` |  |
| `decoration.strokeWidth` |  |
| `scale` |  |
| `textDirection` |  |

## Every bindable field

- `layout.<field>`: `width`, `height`, `constraints`, `margin`, `padding`, `rotation`, `aspectRatio`, `flex`, `squeezable`, `x`, `y`, `align`, `order`, `basis`, and `widthFactor`, `heightFactor`.
- `decoration.<field>`: `fills`, `strokes`, `strokeWidth`, `strokeAlign`, `strokeSides`, `strokeCap`, `dashPattern`, `radius`, `effects`, `clip`, `blendMode`, `foregroundFills`, `shape`. Inside `fills`, `strokes`, `foregroundFills` and `effects`, select an item by `[index]`, by its `id`, or every item by `*`, then a field of [Paint](#type-Paint) or [Effect](#type-Effect) (`decoration.fills[0].color`, `decoration.effects.*.color`, `.offset.dx`).
- `props.<prop>`: any prop of the node's type ([node types](#page-nodes)), and `props.<prop>.<field>` for a field of a model prop.
- `<behavior>` and `<behavior>.<field>`: `motion`, `scale`, `animations`, `transitions`, `inkWell`, `states`, `tooltip`, `ignorePointer`, `zoomable`, `floating`, `hero`, `flightKey`, `flight`, `draggable`, `dropTarget`, `drag`, `reveal`, `strokePath`, `typewriter`, `particles`, `textDirection`, `flip`, `tilt`, `transformGesture`, `sticky`, `viewProgress`, `measure`, `customPaint`.

## Scopes

Names an expression may start with besides the screen's variables: `data`, `route`, `storage`, `screen`, `theme`, `item`, `index`, `parent`, `result`, `loop`, `auth`, `drag`, `perf`, `track`, `transform`, `flip`, `tilt`, `view`, `sticky`, `script`, `speech`, `pageOffset`.

<a id="page-formulas"></a>
# Formula functions

The functions a formula (`${= ...}`) can call, extracted from the SDK's formula engine
(`FormulaEvaluator.functionDocs`). Formulas also have arithmetic (`+ - * / %`), comparisons (`== != < <= > >=`),
`&&`, `||`, `!`, `cond ? a : b`, string and number literals (`'text'`, `"text"`, `3.5`), lists (`[1, 2]`), paths
(`user.name`, `items[0]`), and lambdas for list functions (`x => x.price`).

Formulas are written inside JSON strings, so a backslash in a formula (a regular expression's `\d`) is written
twice in the JSON: `"${= matches(code, '^\\d{4}$')}"`. A text that is exactly one formula keeps the value's type;
inside other text a number is printed without trailing zeros (`${= 2.50}` prints `2.5`).

Source: codelessly_sdk lib/src/runtime/expressions/formula.dart (FormulaEvaluator.functionDocs, FormulaEvaluator.functions).

| Function | Signature | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `left` | `left(text, count)` | `left("MX4821", 2) → MX` |
| `right` | `right(text, count)` | `right("1FUJGLDR5MX4821", 6) → MX4821` |
| `toMap` | `toMap(list, item => key, item => value)` | `toMap(items, i => i.id, i => "pass") → {1a: pass, 1b: pass}` |
| `money` | `money(value, symbol, decimals) or money(value, decimals)` | `money(price) → $1,234.50` |
| `currency` | `currency(value, code, options?)` | `currency(-1234.5, "EUR") → −1.234,50 €; currency(42, "USD", "signed") → +$42.00` |
| `parseAmount` | `parseAmount(text, code)` | `parseAmount("1.234,50", "EUR") → 1234.5` |
| `formatAmount` | `formatAmount(text, code)` | `formatAmount("12345.6", "USD") → 12,345.6` |
| `currencySymbol` | `currencySymbol(code)` | `currencySymbol("GBP") → £` |
| `currencyDecimals` | `currencyDecimals(code)` | `currencyDecimals("JPY") → 0` |
| `formatNumber` | `formatNumber(value, digits?, locale?)` | `formatNumber(2481.64, 1) → 2,481.6 · formatNumber(1234.5, 1, "ar_EG") → ١٬٢٣٤٫٥` |
| `formatCurrency` | `formatCurrency(value, currencyCode, locale?, decimals?)` | `formatCurrency(1234.5, "EUR", "fr_FR") → 1 234,50 € · formatCurrency(1500, "JPY", "ja_JP") → ￥1,500` |
| `formatPercent` | `formatPercent(value, locale?, decimals?)` | `formatPercent(0.42) → 42% · formatPercent(0.42, "fr_FR") → 42 %` |
| `pluralCategory` | `pluralCategory(count, locale?)` | `pluralCategory(3, "ar") → few · pluralCategory(0, "en") → other` |
| `textDirection` | `textDirection(locale)` | `textDirection("he_IL") → rtl · textDirection("fr") → ltr` |
| `textDirectionOf` | `textDirectionOf(text)` | `textDirectionOf("שלום") → rtl · textDirectionOf("123") → (empty)` |
| `fill` | `fill(template, map or list)` | `fill("{i} of {n}", {i: 1, n: 10}) → 1 of 10` |
| `feetInches` | `feetInches(feet)` | `feetInches(6.67) → 6′ 8″` |
| `fixed` | `fixed(value, decimals)` | `fixed(4.5, 2) → 4.50` |
| `round` | `round(value, decimals)` | `round(4.567, 1) → 4.6` |
| `floor` | `floor(value)` | `floor(4.7) → 4` |
| `ceil` | `ceil(value)` | `ceil(4.2) → 5` |
| `abs` | `abs(value)` | `abs(-3) → 3` |
| `min` | `min(a, b, …) or min(list)` | `min(3, 7) → 3` |
| `max` | `max(a, b, …) or max(list)` | `max(3, 7) → 7` |
| `sum` | `sum(list, field or item => value)` | `sum(cart, i => i.price * i.qty) → 24` |
| `count` | `count(list, item => condition) or count(list, field, value)` | `count(tasks, t => !t.done) → 2` |
| `length` | `length(text or list)` | `length(cart) → 3` |
| `if` | `if(condition, then, else)` | `if(qty > 1, "items", "item")` |
| `plural` | `plural(count, one, many) or plural(count, forms, locale?)` | `plural(2, "photo") → photos · plural(2, {one: "{n} phrase", other: "{n} phrases"}, "en") → 2 phrases` |
| `join` | `join(list, separator, field or item => value)` | `join(tags, " · ")` |
| `upper` | `upper(text)` | `upper("hi") → HI` |
| `charCode` | `charCode(text, index)` | `charCode("MX", 1) → 88` |
| `fromCharCode` | `fromCharCode(code, …) or fromCharCode(list)` | `fromCharCode(65 + seat) → B` |
| `lower` | `lower(text)` | `lower("Hi") → hi` |
| `codeUnits` | `codeUnits(text)` | `sum(codeUnits(tag)) % 8 → a stable color index for tag` |
| `trim` | `trim(text)` | `trim("  hi ") → hi` |
| `contains` | `contains(text or list, value)` | `contains(lower(title), lower(search)) → true` |
| `startsWith` | `startsWith(text, prefix)` | `startsWith("Buy milk", "Buy") → true` |
| `endsWith` | `endsWith(text, suffix)` | `endsWith("photo.png", ".png") → true` |
| `padLeft` | `padLeft(value, width, char)` | `padLeft(4, 2) → 04 (numbers pad with 0, text with spaces)` |
| `padRight` | `padRight(value, width, char)` | `padRight("A", 3, ".") → A..` |
| `substring` | `substring(text, start, end)` | `substring("Vinyl", 0, 3) → Vin` |

| `regexReplace` | `regexReplace(text, pattern, to)` | `regexReplace("WILLOW PHARMACY 044", " [0-9]+$", "") → WILLOW PHARMACY; \$1 in to inserts a group` |
| `titleCase` | `titleCase(text)` | `titleCase("SQ *KESTREL FLOWERS") → Sq *Kestrel Flowers` |
| `split` | `split(text, separator)` | `split("rock, jazz", ", ") → [rock, jazz]` |
| `matches` | `matches(text, pattern)` | `matches(code, "^\d{4}$") → true` |
| `slug` | `slug(text)` | `slug("Kind of Blue!") → kind-of-blue` |
| `seconds` | `seconds("m:ss" or "h:mm:ss")` | `seconds("3:45") → 225` |
| `duration` | `duration(seconds)` | `duration(225) → 3:45` |
| `luminance` | `luminance(color)` | `luminance("#FFFFFF") → 1` |
| `filter` | `filter(list, item => condition) or filter(list, field, value)` | `filter(tasks, t => contains(lower(t.title), lower(search)))` |
| `where` | `where(list, field, value) or where(list, item => condition)` | `where(tasks, "done", false)` |
| `find` | `find(list, item => condition) or find(list, field, value)` | `find(users, u => u.id == userId)` |

<a id="page-variables-conditions-scripts"></a>
# Variables, conditions and scripts

Variables, conditions and scripts live at the top of a layout document, keyed by canvas id
(`"variables": {"<canvas id>" | "page_variables": [...]}`, `"conditions": {"<canvas id>": [...]}`), or as a list
(`"scripts"`). See the guide's [variables](#guide-variables) and
[conditions](#guide-conditions) sections for examples.

## Variable fields

| Key | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `"v1"` |  |
| `name` | `"count"` | Unique in its scope; what expressions read (`${name}`). |
| `type` | `"integer"` |  |
| `value` | `3` | The default value, as `type` holds it (see `VariableType.coerce`); null when unset. |
| `formula` | `"a + 1"` | The expression (what goes in `${= ...}`) that computes the value of a computed variable; empty for a plain one. A computed variable is read-only: it changes when what its formula reads changes. |
| `parameters` | `["a"]` | A computed variable with parameters is a function: formulas call it by name (`clamp01(x)`), and its `formula` reads the arguments by these names. |
| `options` | `["a"]` | The options of a `VariableType.choice` variable. |
| `persist` | `true` | Whether the app keeps the value on the device: it starts from the value it had last time (not `value`) and every change is saved. A draft, a list the user builds up. A computed variable can't persist (`persists`). |

### Variable types

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `integer` | A whole number (`int`). |
| `text` | Text (`String`). |
| `decimal` | A number with decimals (`double`). |
| `boolean` | `true` or `false`. |
| `color` | A color, `#AARRGGBB`. |
| `list` | A JSON list. |
| `map` | A JSON object. |
| `image` | An image URL. |
| `choice` | One of `Variable.options`, stored as the option's value. |

## Conditions

An if / else-if / else rule. Its first branch whose test holds and that sets a property gives the property its value; when none does, the property keeps its binding's or its own value. JSON:

```json
{"id": "c1", "name": "Low stock", "branches": [
  {"when": {"left": "${stock}", "op": "lessThan", "right": "5"},
   "set": [{"node": "badge", "path": "visible", "value": true}]},
  {"set": [{"node": "badge", "path": "visible", "value": false}]}]}

```

- Branch: One branch: when `when` holds (always, for an `else`: null), the properties in `sets` take their values.
- Set entry: Sets property `path` (a binding path, DESIGN.md §5.1) of node `node` to `value`: a JSON value, where a string is an expression read like a binding's (`${= qty * 2}`, `#FF0000`, `Hello ${name}`).
- Comparison: `left op right` (the right side only for ops that `ConditionOp.takesRight`).
- Junction: All of `parts` (`and`) or any of them (`or`). Every part is evaluated. JSON: `{"and": [...]}` / `{"or": [...]}`.
- Operand: One side of a `Comparison`: an expression text whose `${...}` are read (`${count}`, `${= a + b}`, `3`, `done`), or, when `raw`, a literal taken as written. Both are then parsed loosely (`3` is a number, `true` a bool, `[1, 2]` a list). JSON: the text, or `{"raw": text}`.

### Comparison ops

| op | Reads right | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `equalsTo` | yes |  |
| `notEqualsTo` | yes |  |
| `greaterThan` | yes |  |
| `lessThan` | yes |  |
| `greaterThanOrEqualTo` | yes |  |
| `lessThanOrEqualTo` | yes |  |
| `isEmpty` | no | Null, or an empty text, list or map. |
| `isNotEmpty` | no |  |
| `contains` | yes | A list holds the right operand, a text contains it, a map has it as a key. |
| `isOdd` | no |  |
| `isEven` | no |  |
| `isNull` | no | Null, or the text `null`. |
| `isTrue` | no |  |
| `isFalse` | no |  |

## Scripts

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `name` | String | `""` |  | A JavaScript identifier: script.<name>(...). |
| `description` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | [{"name", "description", "defaultValue"}]. |
| `source` | String | `""` |  | JavaScript. |
| `version` | int | `1` |  | Goes up each time the script is saved. |
| `capabilities` | List<String> | `[]` |  | What it may do: variables.read, variables.write, nodes.read, navigation, api, cloud, actions, clock. |
| `timeoutMs` | int | `1000` | ≥ 1 |  |
| `memoryLimitMb` | int | `32` | ≥ 1 | Enforced on devices; on the web only `timeoutMs` applies. |
| `pageId` | String | unset |  | Null: a project script. |
| `tests` | Object | unset |  | Sample runs: [{"name", "args", "vars", "nodes", "expect", "expectError"}]. |

## Breakpoints

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | String | `""` |  | Stable id. |
| `name` | String | `""` |  | Name. |
| `minWidth` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | From this width (inclusive). |
| `width` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Design width of its canvases. |
| `height` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Design height of its canvases. |

Defaults:

| id | name | minWidth | design width × height |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mobile` | Mobile | 0 | 390 × 844 |
| `tablet` | Tablet | 600 | 834 × 1112 |
| `desktop` | Desktop | 1024 | 1440 × 900 |
